creative.title: Ideation and Creativity
creative.description: Objective focused on exploring possibilities, brainstorming, and divergent thinking.
creative.ideal_profile: The ideal team excels in Intuition (Ne/Ni) to generate visions, and Feeling (Fi/Fe) to emotionally connect to the idea.

execution.title: Execution and Delivery
execution.description: Objective focused on completing tasks, meeting deadlines, and maintaining order.
execution.ideal_profile: The ideal team heavily uses Extraverted Thinking (Te) to structure work and Sensing (Si/Se) for practical attention.

crisis.title: Crisis Management
crisis.description: Objective focused on immediate reaction to urgent problems, requiring quick decisions and steady nerves.
crisis.ideal_profile: The ideal team requires strong Extraverted Sensing (Se) to react to the immediate and analytical logic (Ti/Te) to resolve the emergency.

innovation.title: Systemic Innovation
innovation.description: Objective focused on reinventing complex systems, products, or technological processes.
innovation.ideal_profile: The ideal team combines the exploration of possibilities (Ne/Ni) with the analytical rigor of Introverted Thinking (Ti) or Extraverted Thinking (Te).

support.title: Care and Support
support.description: Objective focused on people's well-being, group harmony, and emotional/practical support.
support.ideal_profile: The ideal team relies deeply on Extraverted Feeling (Fe) and Introverted Feeling (Fi) combined with attention to detail (Si).

strategy.title: Strategic Planning
strategy.description: Objective focused on defining long-term visions, market analysis, and decision-making architectures.
strategy.ideal_profile: The ideal team has strong Introverted Intuition (Ni) to foresee future scenarios and Thinking (Te/Ti) to structure the strategy.

blind_spots.blindspot_se: Slow to react to the unexpected (Se)
